notes.title: Update and Demo for Prequel
notes.notes:
Dear Owlish Gourmets,

the demo for Owl Observatory, the prequel to Dinner with an Owl, is out now!
Experience a completely new adventure and dive deeper into the time-twisting mysteries of your owlish host.

Try the demo and add the game to your wishlist!

[previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;full][previewyoutube=0rWDOQpACa0;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][/previewyoutube]


In addition to developing Owl Observatory, Dinner with an Owl also received some love!
The newly updated version includes the following changes:

 Added context-sensitive mouse cursors
 Items no longer stick to the cursor after use
 Adjusted the hotspot for Declan
 No more flickering in certain animations of Mr. Webb
 Some minor fixes


Let's have Dinner!
